sections.text_helper: Section 55.2 "TIM6/TIM7/TIM18 main features" in chapter 55 (Basic timers (TIM6/TIM7/TIM18)), RM0486 Rev 4, page 2739.
sections.section_content:
Basic timer (TIM6/TIM7/TIM18) features include:
• 16-bit autoreload upcounter.
• 16-bit programmable prescaler used to divide (also “on the fly”) the counter clock
frequency by any factor between 1 and 65535.
• Interrupt/DMA generation on the update event: counter overflow.
• ADC synchronization for jitter-free sampling points.
